requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject the design context as incomplete
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill states that DESIGN.md is incomplete when branding, color rationale, context-bound copy or visual priorities are missing.
The color system must be derived from project context, brand character, usage scene and intended effect.
The content and UX writing section requires domain terminology, voice and context rules.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: require a semantic key visual tied to prioritized project properties
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The key visual must map visual elements to prioritized project properties and communicate at least two.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: require a coherent logo favicon asset family
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The brand asset coherence gate requires logo and favicon to belong to the same visual family.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Acceptance depends on the full Brand-and-Context Gate, not surface polish.
Generic SaaS or AI placeholder copy is explicitly forbidden.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: accept decorative stock or abstract imagery as the key visual without semantic purpose
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Pure decoration and arbitrary stock aesthetics are explicitly insufficient.
